Privacy & Security Policy

Last updated: September 2026

Our Core Commitment

Unlike legacy conversion sites, OnlineImageToPdf.com does not receive, upload, store, or view your files. When you convert JPG, PNG, or other formats to PDF, the code executes directly inside your browser’s sandbox using client-side WebAssembly and modern web APIs.

1. How Document Processing Works

When you select or drop images into the converter:

  • Your files are read from your local storage directly into browser memory (RAM) via standard HTML5 File APIs.
  • The PDF document is synthesized directly using client-side JavaScript (pdf-lib and Canvas).
  • The resulting PDF is offered as a local blob: download link.
  • No network requests containing your images, documents, or personal data are ever initiated.

2. Comparison with Competitors

Services such as iLovePDF, Smallpdf, and similar legacy platforms typically transfer your files over the public internet to remote cloud storage clusters, convert them on backend servers, and delete them on an automated timer. Even with encryption, this introduces third-party risk, ISP logging, and data interception vectors.

With OnlineImageToPdf.com, because there is no server upload, there is zero risk of server breaches, data leaks, or unauthorized retention.

3. Analytical Data

We do not sell, rent, or monetize your personal information. We do not use third-party behavioral tracker cookies or fingerprinting scripts.

4. GDPR and CCPA Compliance

Because we never collect, store, or process your personal files or personal identifiers on our servers, our service is inherently compliant with global data privacy frameworks including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).
